description: Inputs passed to the Xerberus portfolio what-if policy WASM at evaluation time

wallets.description: Wallet addresses (0x-prefixed) that make up the managed portfolio.

add.description: Hypothetical additions to simulate. At least one of add or remove must be non-empty.

remove.description: Hypothetical removals to simulate. A change with removals and no additions counts as risk-reducing.

chain.description: Optional Xerberus chain identifier. Only ethereum is supported today; defaults to ethereum.

window.description: Optional Xerberus data-window timestamp (ISO-8601). Pass the same value to every xerberus_* pack in a composite.
